label: copy phase, mid-to-late recall, biased toward inputs g/r/o/2/t/3/c/y
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L), never during the original tokens or on the delimiter, and only on repeated tokens (in_first == 0). Almost all mass is at recall_idx >= 2 with to_go <= 5. It is weak at recall_idx 1 and peaks around recall_idx 3-5 and at the final step of L=9 sequences. Within that window it is token-selective but not cleanly: the fed-back input tokens g, r, o, 2, t, 3, c, y fire at about 3x the copy-phase base rate, and outputs c, y, 0, 2, t are also enriched. Activations tend to come in short contiguous runs inside the copy. The token-set predicate covers about 72% of mass, and coverage rises with activation quartile (79% of the top quartile). Precision is only about 0.37, because these tokens often appear in the window without the unit firing. The remaining variance seems to depend on context that per-step token and position variables do not capture.
